relations: Clay O’Rourke 是场地安保负责人，自称 “I’m the head of security, so I can help you with that.”；他用对讲机向下属 Khodi 下令，Khodi 称他 “boss”，他回 “Copy that, boss.”
资深警探 Marsh（“one a senior investigator”，“mid-forties”）与一名较年轻警探（“probably around my age”）到岛上调查，前者是 Clay 的调查对象身份、后者记录口供
Luca（即 Aaron）是曾在此工作的 mentalist，“He worked as a mentalist, so was not on my team”，归另一名 supervisor 管；他在 Clay 的系统里状态是 “Luca resigned”／“he left for personal reasons”
Luca 有假释条件须每周向假释官报到，已漏报两次：“He had a parole condition to check in weekly,” Marsh 说，“He’s missed two.”

Kayla 是 Clay 的伴侣：Clay 说她的身体 “one that is mine”，并答 “Only for you,”；而 Luca/Aaron 是 Kayla “years ago” 离开的旧伴侣：“You haven’t seen him since you left him years ago.” Ares 是 Clay 的同谋，二人在 The Pitt 事件后 “came up with a plan” 并 “manipulated the camera footage”
numbers: not even eight in the morning

facts.fact: Clay 在 The Pitt 警察找上门后的一周于桥近侧前门加设安保岗，拦下任何来岛的警察
facts.anchor: Last week, after the police showed up at The Pitt, I put security at the front gate, on the near side of the bridge, to intercept them if they come here.

facts.fact: Becker 打电话报告有两名警察到场，Clay 随即用对讲机命令 Khodi 不许任何人进前门并赶往大门
facts.anchor: I end the call and radio Khodi. “Do not let anyone in the front gate. I’m on my way.”

facts.fact: 资深探员 Marsh 出示警徽，要求就一名在此工作过的员工 Luca 问话；Clay 把两人带进保安室、避开主区域以免引起恐慌
facts.anchor: “Detective Marsh. We are hoping to speak to someone regarding an employee who worked here—Luca.”

facts.fact: Clay 以 Luca 因个人原因辞职作答；Marsh 抛出 Luca 有每周假释报到义务、已漏报两次，Clay 回应入职时只走第三方背景调查、无人被标记
facts.anchor: “He had a parole condition to check in weekly,” Marsh says, watching for my reaction. “He’s missed two.”

facts.fact: Clay 刻意主动表示愿意全力配合，判断有事瞒着的人不会主动示好，以此试探两名警探是否起疑
facts.anchor: I add the last part deliberately, as people who have something to hide rarely volunteer their cooperation.

facts.fact: Clay 向 Kayla 交底：Ares 出了主意篡改监控录像（摄像头当时已停），补出带修改后时间与日期的全岛录像，且没有 Aaron 返回的录像
facts.anchor: She and Ares told us about what happened at The Pitt, and Ares came up with a plan. We manipulated the camera footage, even when the cameras were down.

facts.fact: Clay 要 Kayla 当面复述封口口径，Kayla 说出 {L}I know nothing{R} 后眯眼盯住他
facts.anchor: “I know nothing,” she says, narrowing her eyes at me.

facts.fact: Clay 与 Kayla 在厨房发生关系，并在她颈上留下占有标记，要所有人看到
facts.anchor: I leave my mark, needing everyone to see I claimed what is mine.
